blurb.en: A preview of what lies past the Rift. Delivered over the air.

brief.en: The Rift is behind you. The pull is not.

hints.en: What you learned about black holes still holds out here.

brief.en: Two dark wells, one narrow lane between them.

hints.en: Aim for the lane's middle and let both pulls cancel out.

brief.en: Echo has been waiting out here, listening to every shot you fired.

hints.en: Change your angle first; Echo expects your old power.

brief.en: Shots that skim the dark come back faster than they left.

hints.en: A close pass adds speed; take a little power away.

brief.en: Warden Horizon was not the last guardian. Arriving soon.

taunts.en: Past the edge, there is only me.
Light doesn't leave. Neither will you.
